related.title: 張北柔性直流電網
related.transfer: 可遷移「以輸電代替輸煤」與「可用率與輸電量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wire in place of coal trains" and "Availability and energy transferred" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦三千公里、一千一百千伏的直流輸電：額定電流、以輸電代替輸煤、與八百千伏的比較、閘流體閥與雙極閉鎖；張北柔性直流電網則以世界第一個直流電網：四端環網、年輸送電量、子模組電容的儲能、故障電流的上升率與直流斷路器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on three thousand kilometres at eleven hundred kilovolts DC: rated current, wire in place of coal trains, comparison with eight hundred kilovolts, thyristor valves and bipole block; Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid centres on the first DC grid in the world: a four-terminal ring, yearly energy, energy in submodule capacitors, fault current rise and DC breakers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「額定電流」與「年輸送電量占北京用電的比例」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「與 ±800 kV 相比的損失」的模型移到張北柔性直流電網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流故障電流的上升率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Rated current" and "Yearly energy as a share of Beijing demand".
Move the model of "Loss compared with ±800 kV" to Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rate of rise of DC fault current", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「以輸電代替輸煤」與「可用率與輸電量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wire in place of coal trains" and "Availability and energy transferred" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.

related.title: 北海聯網海底直流電纜
related.titleEn: North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector
related.transfer: 可遷移「以輸電代替輸煤」與「可用率與輸電量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；北海聯網海底直流電纜的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wire in place of coal trains" and "Availability and energy transferred" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦三千公里、一千一百千伏的直流輸電：額定電流、以輸電代替輸煤、與八百千伏的比較、閘流體閥與雙極閉鎖；北海聯網海底直流電纜則以七百二十公里的海底電纜把英國的風接上挪威的水庫：價差收入、省下的水、電纜的重量、深水敷設與最大單一事故為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on three thousand kilometres at eleven hundred kilovolts DC: rated current, wire in place of coal trains, comparison with eight hundred kilovolts, thyristor valves and bipole block; North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector centres on A 720-kilometre subsea cable joining British wind to Norwegian reservoirs: spread income, water saved, cable weight, deep-water laying and the largest single loss, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「額定電流」與「價差與擁塞收入」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「與 ±800 kV 相比的損失」的模型移到北海聯網海底直流電纜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流線路損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Rated current" and "Price spread and congestion income".
Move the model of "Loss compared with ±800 kV" to North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC line loss", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「以輸電代替輸煤」與「可用率與輸電量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；北海聯網海底直流電纜的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Wire in place of coal trains" and "Availability and energy transferred" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.
